scope: Atlas exposes hidden source/space filters and distinct unpublished/missing-artwork empty states without changing scanner publication. Rewards displays minted medal families in an open gallery, leaving all achievements, original animations, reader and protected layouts elsewhere intact.
owner_approval: User requested unpopulated Atlas correction and improved unboxed Rewards presentation, 17 October 2026
